claim: The fiscal first quarter of 2025 filing puts Walmart's operating income at $7 million.
summary: Walmart's quarterly operating income is on the scale of billions, not single-digit millions; $7 million for fiscal Q1 2025 is three orders of magnitude too low and reflects a million-for-billion unit error.

sub_claims.text: Walmart's fiscal first quarter of 2025 operating income was $7 million.
sub_claims.note: From general knowledge Walmart has ~$160B quarterly revenue and ~$6-7B quarterly operating income in this period; $7 million is implausibly low by ~1000x, consistent with a billion vs million unit mistake. No citation used per instructions.
